candidates.name: Tarlov cyst
support_spans: a well-defined, nonenhancing, unilocular hypodense cystic lesion anterior to the rectum
a separate 4.4 × 4.7 cm cyst in the left perineum
homoogeneous, T1 hypointense, T2 hyperintense, and showed no wall enhancement
candidates.why: The patient's symptoms and imaging findings are consistent with Tarlov cysts, which are fluid-filled sacs that can compress nearby nerves and cause symptoms such as numbness and constipation.
